newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Dresden unit seen up later this week.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Dresden unit seen up later this week.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's (ComEd) 794 megawatt Dresden nuclear power unit 3 is expected to return to service later this week following a maintenance shutdown, a company spokesman said Monday.
"Right now we are looking at (startup) later this week," company spokesman Gary Wald said.
The unit, located in Morris, Ill., was shut October 26, 1996 for maintenance.
"The unit is ready to run but we are awaiting NRC (Nuclear Regulatory Agency) approval for changes to our technical specifications," Wald said.
The adjacent 794 megawatt Dresden nuclear power unit 2 was operating normally and had been on line without incident for the past 144 days, Wald said.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
